evidence: Read every criterion description in all five judge.toml files (2 gates, 46 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) looking for the workbook defect: enumerating several requirements then waiving most, leaving two targets. None found. (1) Every binary functional/polish/gate criterion closes with the catch-all 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold.', which binds the positive enumeration and the specific Fails-if list to ONE conjunctive bar; e.g. hro_add_candidate (functional/judge.toml:38) states 'The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' after the Fails list, and the catch-all still covers it; hro_activity (:272) 'The Observer can read the same lines' likewise precedes the catch-all. (2) Every relaxation present is a defined alternative or scope exclusion, not a waiver of the enumerated bar: 'hiding it is optional' with UI-or-replay refusal (hro_move_one_stage :56, hro_reject_hired :92, hro_mgr_other_job :164); 'on the card, its details, its reopen control or its Activity line' (hro_reject_reason :83); 'A UI that refuses before the card moves ... also passes' (hro_refused_put_back :137) keeps the same three legs (real place, reason, focus); 'refused, or answered with only what the candidate's own view shows' (hro_candidate_private :398) is defined with the forbidden data list; 'notes and messages need not appear in Activity' (hro_activity :272) clarifies items not in the enumerated action list; 'only those that were refused count here ... If none ... this row is 0' (hro_refusal_status :200) is a single explicit bar; render gate 'a refusal message is welcome but not required' (gates/render/judge.toml) never enumerates the message as required. Ownership sentences ('belongs to hro_bulk_move', 'graded only in hro_candidate_linked', 'This row owns the draft and focus; where the view goes while reading earlier messages is graded in Functional' polish:32) exclude out-of-scope observables rather than waiving listed legs; in hro_pol_live_thread the exclusion is limited to reading earlier messages, while the view-at-newest leg remains in its Fails list. (3) The only conditional waiver of a listed leg is hro_pol_live_board (polish/judge.toml:23): the scroll leg is skipped only 'if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards in one stage, record that and judge the other legs'. This is one leg under a deterministic, recorded precondition (scroll reset is physically unobservable), not 'waive most'; the bar remains single. (4) Visual likert criteria each state one dimension with five anchors (visual/judge.toml:23-89); no competing bars. (5) Cross-check with functional prompt protocols: protocol steps match criterion legs (L refusal/focus, K candidate replies, U seen/unread, C stale move). The prompt's protocol A says '(notes are not recorded in Activity)' while hro_activity says notes 'need not appear'; the criterion is the scored bar and its Fails list never penalizes a note line, so this is wording drift, not a second target (recorded as a minor observation). Counterexample attempts: a broken app that renders team/email/source nowhere passes the display legs of hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate by design ('wherever the app shows'), but team display is separately required in hro_candidate_view and this is a conditional, not a self-contradiction (whether the brief requires staff-side display is a coverage row, not #33). A conforming app that logs notes in Activity is not failed by hro_activity's wording. Per skill Known false positives and the internal annotation, bundled flow criteria (e.g. hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_unread_counts) are conjunctive single bars, not #33 defects; whether they should be split for independent credit is REVIEW_POLICY/rows 26/28, outside this row. This row is a source-text judgement; no runtime evidence is required for it, so no measurement gap is attributed. raw-evidence-index.json exists (keys input_sha256, scope, entries) but was not needed or relied on for this row. Pass for row 33 only; it is not proof the task passes.
suggested_fix: Optional polish (not a #33 defect): align functional prompt protocol A '(notes are not recorded in Activity)' with hro_activity's 'notes and messages need not appear in Activity' so prompt and criterion use the same permissive wording.
